notes: measure:false, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19, pending the author): 1,3B+ is 0,4B+ minus CO2 for every listed flavone, so the required 1,3B+ with 0,4B+ is one parent-daughter channel; 0,4B+-H2O stays an alternative to 0,4B+.

competitors.note: kaempferol shares C15H10O6 with luteolin and gives nominal 135, luteolin's 1,3B+, at 2-3 % (Abranko 2015 p. 77); by calculation its [M+H-C6H6O3]+, the complement of (1,4A+)+2H, would be C9H5O3+, luteolin's 0,4B+-H2O formula (inference)

genistein shares C15H10O5 with apigenin and biochanin A C16H12O5 with acacetin; by calculation they would give every target formula (1,3A+, 1,3B+, 0,4B+ and 0,4B+-H2O), and no cited positive-mode source contrasts flavones with isoflavones
